ticket.title: Add a blast-off countdown
ticket.description: Show passengers the remaining seconds until the Spaceways launch window opens.
requirements: Decrease the displayed value once per second.
Stop at 0 and display Blast off!.

pr.title: Add blast-off countdown timer
pr.description: Adds a reusable launch countdown helper for the departure board.
pr.author: nova-dev

aiReview.summary: The countdown moves in the wrong direction and can never reach the blast-off condition, so it does not meet the ticket requirements.

findings.title: Countdown increments instead of decrementing
findings.detail: Each invocation adds one to the remaining seconds. Starting at 10 means the value will increase indefinitely rather than reach 0.

findings.title: Blast-off message is unreachable
findings.detail: Because the counter starts at 10 and is incremented before the equality check, it cannot equal 0 and will never return the required message.

proposedAnswer.reason: Logic issue: Increments rather than decrements
